_comment: Shared golden for the Everdrive N8 Pro (Edio) protocol FRAMING. The TS impl (src/n8/edio.ts) and the C++ impl (packages/native/src/host/n8/Edio.cpp) are byte-for-byte twins; BOTH edio.test.ts and Edio.test.cpp drive each case below and assert the emitted bytes against THIS file. So a framing change in either impl fails the other's test until both impls AND this golden agree - the single source that forces them to stay in sync. `writes` is the exact hex the op emits; `reads` is hex queued for the port's reads so an op that polls a reply doesn't time out (values are the on-wire byte order). Behavioural checks (return values, throws, dir decode, N8Link) stay in the per-language tests.
